name: Moving Slit Display
definition: A moving-slit display without additional lenses in front of the CRT, where corresponding columns of different views are displayed side-by-side behind the slit aperture.
summary: The Moving Slit Display, or Holotron, creates glasses-free volumetric images by projecting multiplexed views through a laterally moving physical slit aperture, distinguishing itself from static lens-based systems.
